project.name: Spatial Anubis — Selemene BFF Integration
assumptions: Selemene Engine is deployed and reachable via HTTP at a configurable base URL
Bun runtime >= 1.1 available in dev and CI environments
Hono framework provides routing, middleware composition, and Bun-native performance
Drizzle ORM targets a local SQLite database for dev; Postgres for staging/prod
JWT tokens are issued by a separate auth service; BFF validates them only
All 13 Selemene-backed engines expose a uniform /engine/:engineId/read POST contract
Rune Stones and Somatic Canticle are self-contained custom engines with no Selemene dependency
Field Journal entries are append-only; no deletion of historical readings
Rate limiting is per-user, enforced via sliding-window counter in memory (Redis upgrade later)
Sigil Forge is an existing Selemene workflow absorbed into the West Wing Sigil BFF endpoint
risks: Selemene downtime blocks 13 of 15 engines; fallback cache must serve stale readings gracefully
Transformer schema drift if Selemene API evolves without versioning contract
JWT validation latency on every request could degrade P99 if JWKS fetch is not cached
SQLite write contention under concurrent sessions during dev; mitigated by WAL mode
Custom engines (Runes, Somatic Canticle) lack external validation source; rely solely on unit tests
Decision Mirror convergence scoring is heuristic; acceptance criteria thresholds may need tuning
Bio-gate 423 Locked state in Somatic Canticle is a hard-coded business rule with no unlock path yet

phases.name: Selemene Integration — BFF Layer
phases.objective: Stand up the Backend-for-Frontend layer that bridges Spatial Anubis UI to the Selemene Engine, transforming raw engine readings into display-ready payloads for all 15 engines, with auth, rate limiting, session persistence, and graceful Selemene-down fallback.

sprints.name: BFF Foundation
sprints.goal: Scaffold Bun+Hono project, wire Selemene client with health polling and fallback, define Drizzle schemas, implement auth and rate limiting middleware, create engine router and transformer registry.

tasks.title: Initialize Bun project with Hono framework in bff/ directory
tasks.deliverable: A working bff/ directory with bun init, Hono dependency, tsconfig.json, and a runnable dev script.
tasks.acceptance: Running `bun run dev` in bff/ starts a process that listens on port 3001 without errors.

tasks.title: Configure TypeScript strict mode and path aliases
tasks.deliverable: tsconfig.json with strict: true, paths aliases (@/services, @/schemas, @/middleware, @/routes), and bun-compatible module resolution.
tasks.acceptance: Importing a module via @/services/example resolves correctly and `bun run typecheck` passes with zero errors.

tasks.title: Create Hono server entry point with health endpoint
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/index.ts exporting a Hono app with GET /health returning { status: 'ok', uptime_ms: number }.
tasks.acceptance: curl localhost:3001/health returns 200 with a valid JSON body containing status 'ok' and a positive uptime_ms value.

tasks.title: Implement Selemene API client class
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/services/selemene-client.ts with typed methods for engine reads, workflow calls, and health checks using fetch with configurable base URL and timeout.
tasks.acceptance: SelemeneClient.healthCheck() returns a typed HealthResponse and SelemeneClient.readEngine(engineId, payload) returns a typed SelemeneResponse when called against a mock server.

tasks.title: Add Selemene health check polling on BFF startup
tasks.deliverable: Startup hook that polls Selemene /health every 30s, logs status, and sets a global isSelemeneUp boolean flag.
tasks.acceptance: BFF logs 'Selemene: connected' on successful poll and 'Selemene: unreachable' when the poll fails, toggling the flag accordingly.

tasks.title: Implement Selemene fallback mode with cached readings
tasks.deliverable: FallbackCache service that stores the last successful reading per engine per user and serves it with a stale: true flag when Selemene is down.
tasks.acceptance: When isSelemeneUp is false, engine read requests return the cached reading with stale: true and a cache_age_ms field, instead of a 503 error.

tasks.title: Define Zod schemas for SelemeneResponse and Engine3DResponse
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/schemas/selemene.ts with Zod schemas for raw Selemene payloads and bff/src/schemas/engine3d.ts for transformed display-ready payloads.
tasks.acceptance: Parsing a valid Selemene JSON fixture through the Zod schema succeeds, and parsing a malformed fixture throws a ZodError with descriptive path.

tasks.title: Create Drizzle ORM schema for user_profiles table
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/db/schema/user-profiles.ts defining user_profiles table with id, birth_datetime, birth_lat, birth_lng, vessel_type, preferences JSON, created_at, updated_at.
tasks.acceptance: Drizzle generates a valid SQL migration file for user_profiles and the table is created successfully in a fresh SQLite database.

tasks.title: Create Drizzle ORM schema for engine_readings table
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/db/schema/engine-readings.ts defining engine_readings table with id, user_id FK, engine_id, session_id, raw_payload JSON, transformed_payload JSON, convergence_score, created_at.
tasks.acceptance: Drizzle generates a valid migration for engine_readings with foreign key to user_profiles and the table is created in a fresh SQLite database.

tasks.title: Create Drizzle ORM schema for user_sessions table
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/db/schema/user-sessions.ts defining user_sessions table with id, user_id FK, started_at, ended_at, unlocked_zones JSON, dasha_period, session_metadata JSON.
tasks.acceptance: Drizzle generates a valid migration for user_sessions with foreign key to user_profiles and nullable ended_at for active session detection.

tasks.title: Implement Drizzle migration runner and seed script
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/db/migrate.ts that runs all pending migrations and bff/src/db/seed.ts that inserts a test user with sample birth data.
tasks.acceptance: Running `bun run db:migrate && bun run db:seed` creates all three tables and inserts one test user row retrievable via Drizzle query.

tasks.title: Implement JWT auth middleware for Hono
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/middleware/auth.ts that validates Bearer JWT tokens, extracts user_id into Hono context, and returns 401 on invalid/missing tokens.
tasks.acceptance: Requests with a valid JWT set c.get('userId') and proceed; requests without a token or with an expired token receive a 401 JSON error.

tasks.title: Implement per-user rate limiting middleware
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/middleware/rate-limit.ts using a sliding-window in-memory counter keyed by user_id, configurable window and max requests.
tasks.acceptance: A user exceeding 60 requests per minute receives a 429 JSON error with retry_after_ms, while a user under the limit proceeds normally.

tasks.title: Create unified engine router at /api/engines/:engineId
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/routes/engines.ts with POST /api/engines/:engineId that resolves the transformer from the registry, calls Selemene, and returns the transformed payload.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/engines/vimshottari-dasha with valid JWT and body returns a 200 with a transformed Engine3DResponse payload (or 404 for unknown engineId).

tasks.title: Implement EngineTransformer interface and TransformerRegistry
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/registry.ts defining the EngineTransformer interface (transform, engineId, displayConfig) and a TransformerRegistry that maps engineId strings to transformer instances.
tasks.acceptance: TransformerRegistry.get('vimshottari-dasha') returns the registered transformer instance and TransformerRegistry.get('nonexistent') returns undefined.

tasks.title: Create shared constants for brand palette, display config, and PIP defaults
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/constants/brand.ts with color palette, bff/src/constants/display.ts with default 3D display configs, and bff/src/constants/pip.ts with PIP overlay defaults.
tasks.acceptance: Importing BRAND_PALETTE, DEFAULT_DISPLAY_CONFIG, and PIP_DEFAULTS yields typed, non-empty objects that pass their respective Zod schema validations.

sprints.name: Engine Transformers
sprints.goal: Implement all 13 Selemene-backed EngineTransformers (8 core + 5 bonus), 2 custom engines (Rune Stones, Somatic Canticle), and absorb Sigil Forge into the BFF layer.

tasks.title: Implement Vimshottari Dasha transformer with Panchanga absorption
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/vimshottari-dasha.ts that transforms Selemene dasha response into layered timeline data with Panchanga tithi/nakshatra as secondary overlay.
tasks.acceptance: Given a Selemene dasha fixture, the transformer outputs an Engine3DResponse with mahadasha, antardasha, and pratyantardasha layers plus a panchanga overlay array.

tasks.title: Implement I-Ching Oracle transformer with physics coin input
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/i-ching-oracle.ts that maps 6 coin-toss results to a hexagram, sends to Selemene, and transforms the oracle response into line-by-line 3D display data.
tasks.acceptance: Given 6 coin values [2,3,2,3,3,2], the transformer resolves the correct hexagram number and returns an Engine3DResponse with hexagram, changing_lines, and reading_text fields.

tasks.title: Implement Tarot Arcana transformer with spread support
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/tarot-arcana.ts that sends card IDs with reversed flags and spread type to Selemene and transforms into positional card display data.
tasks.acceptance: Given a 3-card Celtic Cross subset with one reversed card, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with card positions, imagery descriptors, and reversed indicators.

tasks.title: Implement Numerology Matrix transformer for Pythagorean and Chaldean
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/numerology-matrix.ts that computes both Pythagorean and Chaldean number mappings from user name/birth data and transforms Selemene response into a grid display.
tasks.acceptance: Given birth name 'Daniel' and DOB, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with life_path, expression, soul_urge numbers for both systems in a matrix layout.

tasks.title: Implement Biorhythm Compass transformer with 23/28/33-day cycles
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/biorhythm-compass.ts that calculates physical (23d), emotional (28d), intellectual (33d) sine curves from birth date and transforms into waveform display data.
tasks.acceptance: Given a birth date and target date, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with three cycle arrays (values -1 to 1), critical_days flags, and a composite_score.

tasks.title: Implement Gene Keys Helix transformer with Shadow-Gift-Siddhi mapping
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/gene-keys-helix.ts that maps Selemene gene key activations to the Shadow-Gift-Siddhi spectrum with helix visualization coordinates.
tasks.acceptance: Given a gene key number (1-64), the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with shadow, gift, siddhi labels, codon_ring, and helix_position as 3D coordinates.

tasks.title: Implement Human Design Bodygraph transformer with 9 centers and 36 channels
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/human-design-bodygraph.ts that transforms Selemene bodygraph data into 9 center states (defined/undefined), 36 channel activations, and type/authority/strategy.
tasks.acceptance: Given a Selemene bodygraph fixture, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with centers array (9 items), channels array (36 items), type, authority, strategy, and profile.

tasks.title: Implement Chronobiology Clock transformer with vedic_clock circadian adapter
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/chronobiology-clock.ts that adapts Selemene vedic_clock output into circadian rhythm segments with dosha-period overlays for time-of-day guidance.
tasks.acceptance: Given current time and user timezone, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with 8 prahara segments, active_dosha, optimal_activities array, and circadian_phase.

tasks.title: Implement Enneagram Compass transformer with type, wing, and growth/stress arrows
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/enneagram-compass.ts that transforms Selemene enneagram data into type + wing identification with growth and stress direction arrows for 3D compass display.
tasks.acceptance: Given enneagram type 4 with wing 5, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with core_type, wing, growth_direction (1), stress_direction (2), instinct_stack, and center.

tasks.title: Implement Sacred Geometry Matrix transformer with golden ratio vertices
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/sacred-geometry-matrix.ts that transforms Selemene geometry patterns into vertex arrays with golden ratio proportions for 3D rendering.
tasks.acceptance: Given a pattern type (e.g., 'flower-of-life'), the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with vertices array, edges array, golden_ratio_points, and symmetry_group.

tasks.title: Implement Biofield Scanner transformer with field layers and anomaly zones
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/biofield-scanner.ts that transforms Selemene biofield data into concentric field layers with anomaly zone markers for 3D body overlay.
tasks.acceptance: Given a Selemene biofield fixture, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with layers array (7 auric layers), anomaly_zones with coordinates, and overall_coherence score.

tasks.title: Implement Face Reading Mirror transformer with element balance
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/face-reading-mirror.ts that transforms Selemene face reading data into facial region annotations with five-element balance scoring.
tasks.acceptance: Given a face reading fixture, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with regions array (forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, chin), element_balance object (5 elements), and palace_readings.

tasks.title: Implement Nadabrahman Resonator transformer with harmonic series
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/transformers/nadabrahman-resonator.ts that transforms Selemene frequency data into a fundamental + harmonics series with chakra resonance mapping.
tasks.acceptance: Given a fundamental frequency, the transformer returns an Engine3DResponse with fundamental_hz, harmonics array (8 overtones), chakra_map (7 resonances), and nada_type.

tasks.title: Implement Rune Stones custom engine with Elder Futhark lookup
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/engines/rune-stones.ts with full 24 Elder Futhark rune definitions, spatial scoring algorithm, and direct Engine3DResponse output with no Selemene dependency.
tasks.acceptance: Calling RuneStones.cast(3) returns an Engine3DResponse with 3 rune objects each containing name, symbol, meaning, reversed_meaning, aett, and spatial_score.

tasks.title: Implement Somatic Canticle custom engine with bio-gate 423 Locked
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/engines/somatic-canticle.ts with markdown content store, body-region mapping, and hard-coded bio-gate 423 Locked state returning a sealed response.
tasks.acceptance: Requesting any canticle returns an Engine3DResponse with body_region, canticle_text, and gate_status; requesting gate 423 specifically returns gate_status: 'locked' with sealed_message.

tasks.title: Absorb Selemene sigil_forge into West Wing Sigil BFF endpoint
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/routes/sigil-forge.ts that wraps Selemene sigil_forge workflow into POST /api/sigils/forge endpoint with intent validation and SVG path output.
tasks.acceptance: POST /api/sigils/forge with intent string returns a 200 with an Engine3DResponse containing sigil_svg_path, intent_hash, charge_level, and activation_phrase.

sprints.name: Synthesis, Persistence & Testing
sprints.goal: Build composite engines (Decision Mirror, Cartographer's Compass), implement user profile and session persistence layer, and write comprehensive integration and unit tests for all engines.

tasks.title: Implement Decision Mirror composite engine with convergence scoring
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/engines/decision-mirror.ts that calls Selemene decision-support workflow, aggregates 3+ engine readings from the Field Journal, and computes a convergence score.
tasks.acceptance: Given 3 prior engine readings in the Field Journal, the Decision Mirror returns an Engine3DResponse with convergence_score (0-1), aligned_themes array, and decision_vectors.

tasks.title: Implement Cartographer's Compass composite engine with coherence matrix
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/engines/cartographers-compass.ts that calls Selemene full-spectrum workflow and builds a session history coherence matrix across all prior readings.
tasks.acceptance: Given a session with 5+ readings, the Cartographer returns an Engine3DResponse with coherence_matrix (NxN), dominant_archetypes array, and journey_trajectory coordinates.

tasks.title: Implement user profile CRUD endpoints
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/routes/profiles.ts with GET/PUT /api/profile for birth data, preferences, and vessel type management.
tasks.acceptance: PUT /api/profile with birth_datetime and vessel_type updates the user row and GET /api/profile returns the full profile with all fields populated.

tasks.title: Implement reading history persistence for Field Journal
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/services/field-journal.ts that persists every engine reading to engine_readings table with raw and transformed payloads plus Selemene request metadata.
tasks.acceptance: After an engine read via /api/engines/:engineId, a new row exists in engine_readings with matching user_id, engine_id, session_id, and both raw/transformed JSON payloads.

tasks.title: Implement session management endpoints
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/routes/sessions.ts with POST /api/sessions (create), PUT /api/sessions/:id/end, and GET /api/sessions/:id for unlocked zones and Dasha period.
tasks.acceptance: Creating a session returns a session_id, ending it sets ended_at, and GET returns unlocked_zones array and current dasha_period string.

tasks.title: Implement Return Protocol with session age check
tasks.deliverable: bff/src/services/return-protocol.ts that checks session age and returns either compressed Descent (for recent returns) or full Descent (for cold starts).
tasks.acceptance: A returning user within 24h receives compressed descent_mode: 'compressed' with summary; a user returning after 7+ days receives descent_mode: 'full' with complete sequence.

tasks.title: Write Selemene-backed core engine integration tests
tasks.deliverable: bff/tests/integration/core-engines.test.ts with end-to-end tests for all 8 core Selemene engines using a mock Selemene server with fixture responses.
tasks.acceptance: All 8 core engine tests pass, each verifying: correct Selemene endpoint called, valid Engine3DResponse schema, and proper error handling on Selemene 500.

tasks.title: Write bonus engine integration tests
tasks.deliverable: bff/tests/integration/bonus-engines.test.ts with end-to-end tests for all 5 bonus Selemene engines using mock Selemene server.
tasks.acceptance: All 5 bonus engine tests pass, verifying correct Selemene calls, valid schema output, and graceful degradation on timeout.

tasks.title: Write custom engine unit tests for Runes and Somatic Canticle
tasks.deliverable: bff/tests/unit/rune-stones.test.ts and bff/tests/unit/somatic-canticle.test.ts covering all rune lookups, spatial scoring, canticle retrieval, and gate 423 locked state.
tasks.acceptance: Rune tests verify all 24 Elder Futhark entries are present and spatial scoring produces values in [0,1]; Somatic Canticle tests verify gate 423 returns locked status.

tasks.title: Write Decision Mirror convergence test with multi-engine input
tasks.deliverable: bff/tests/integration/decision-mirror.test.ts that seeds 3+ engine readings into the Field Journal and verifies convergence scoring produces valid aligned themes.
tasks.acceptance: Test seeds readings from Dasha, Tarot, and Numerology engines, calls Decision Mirror, and asserts convergence_score is a number in [0,1] with at least 1 aligned_theme.

tasks.title: Write rate limiting verification tests
tasks.deliverable: bff/tests/integration/rate-limit.test.ts that verifies per-user rate limiting triggers 429 after threshold and resets after window expiry.
tasks.acceptance: Test sends 61 requests in 60 seconds for one user and asserts the 61st returns 429 with retry_after_ms, while a second user's requests in the same window succeed.

tasks.title: Write Selemene-down fallback mode test
tasks.deliverable: bff/tests/integration/fallback-mode.test.ts that simulates Selemene unreachable, verifies cached readings are served with stale flag, and recovery resumes fresh reads.
tasks.acceptance: Test makes a successful reading, kills mock Selemene, retries and gets stale: true cached response, restarts mock, and next request returns stale: false fresh data.
